subject: Deployment mode & cost modeling - AcmeAI evaluation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment mode discussion - post-call recap & next steps

Alex,

Thanks again for the call today - really appreciate the context on your fraud-detection use case and the throughput requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we stay aligned.

Recap:
- Workload: near-real-time scoring for user events, ~200 QPS peak, average 40 QPS; typical prompt size ~120 tokens; average response 60 tokens.
- Data sensitivity: PII present in payloads; customer prefers data isolation and stronger controls.
- Priority: predictability (SLAs) and cost efficiency for steady-state traffic.

Deployment modes we discussed (pros/cons):
1) Hosted API - fastest to go live, usage-based per-token pricing. Good fit for early experiments but harder to guarantee isolation and strict SLAs without dedicated capacity.
2) Dedicated capacity - reserved GPU pools (monthly commit) for predictable throughput and isolation; unit economics improve with committed capacity.
3) Private VPC/on-prem - for regulated environments; full isolation and KMS/HSM integration but longer onboarding and higher fixed costs.

What we need from you to model costs accurately:
- Confirmation of expected steady-state QPS and expected peak QPS.
- Expected monthly active user count (or total monthly tokens).
- Any procurement constraints (PO timeline, budget cadence).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_summary.xlsx (pricing bands), deployment_comparison.pdf (short explainer).

Proposed next steps:
1) If you can share a 7-14 day sample of token counts (CSV or BigQuery link) we'll produce a side-by-side cost model for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
2) I'll put together two committed+overage pricing options for Dedicated (12-mo commit and 36-mo commit) and a per-token Hosted comparison.
3) Sync next week - do you have 30 minutes Tue or Wed morning PT?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0184

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion - post-call recap & next steps

Aditya -

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications so you can start the modeling:
- Steady-state: ~40 QPS (average) across US; peak ~220 QPS during business hours.
- Monthly tokens: based on current telemetry we estimate ~350M input tokens and ~175M output tokens/month (~525M total). Will confirm with a short export.
- Data requirements: must be covered under a private tenancy or dedicated capacity with VPC peering; SOC 2 compliance required.
- Procurement: we usually do annual contracts, procurement window opens mid-Jan. PO lead is procurement@acmeai.com.

Attaching a 14-day sample of token-level counts (acme_usage_sample.csv). Please model:
A) Hosted per-token (standard rates) - show estimated monthly cost and projected 12-mo spend.
B) Dedicated 1-year commit - show cost for 2 sizing options (reserve for steady-state 40 QPS and reserve for 75% of peak 220 QPS). Include overage pricing.
C) Private VPC - rough sizing and one-time onboarding estimate.

Happy to sync Tue 12/1 10am PT - does that work?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering | AcmeAI
alex.johnson@acmeai.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion - post-call recap & next steps

Alex -

Appreciate the data. I ran preliminary numbers and attached a more detailed capacity_pricing_breakdown.pdf with three scenarios. Summary here to make it actionable:

A) Hosted (per-token) - baseline estimate
- Estimated monthly tokens: 525M
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$52,500 (per-token tier applied; includes 10% discount for expected volume).
- Pros: lowest up-front, fastest to start.
- Cons: weaker isolation controls; would need contractual controls for data residency.

B) Dedicated (1-yr commit) - two sizing options
Option 1: Reserve for steady-state (40 QPS)
- Equivalent reserved capacity: ~2 x r5-like GPU pods (example sizing in PDF).
- Monthly committed fee: ~$30,000; overage: per-token at a reduced rate.
- 12-mo committed spend: ~$360k. Break-even vs Hosted after ~7 months given your usage profile.

Option 2: Reserve for 75% peak (165 QPS) - preferred if you need headroom
- Monthly committed fee: ~$95,000; 12-mo: ~$1.14M. Better p95 latency guarantees and capacity headroom for bursts.

C) Private VPC/on-prem (estimate)
- One-time onboarding and infra setup: $120k-$220k depending on on-prem vs cloud VPC architecture.
- Monthly platform fee + reserved capacity similar to Dedicated but with added HSM/KMS costs.
- Longer procurement/onboarding (6-12 weeks).

Recommendations:
- For your stated requirements (regulatory + steady traffic): Dedicated 1-yr commit (Option 1) hits a good balance of cost and isolation; Option 2 if you need comfortable headroom for peaks.
- We can structure a hybrid: start Hosted for 4-8 weeks while provisioning Dedicated capacity and onboard to Dedicated once agreed to a commit.

Next steps I can take this week:
1) Finalize the excel model with month-by-month spend and a 12- and 36-month total cost comparison.
2) Draft a short SOW and procurement-ready pricing sheet for procurement@acmeai.com.
3) Tentative 30-min sync Tue 12/1 10:00am PT to review.

Best,
